pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 80 °C·d above 4 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1100 °C·d$(). Best near 18 °C; stops above 30 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -8 °C (-4 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7.5 (tolerates 5.5-8). Roots 0.6 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 180, P 28, K 200 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 22 tons/ac (50 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Cabbage and Cabbage Seeds.
